prompt:
You are an experienced sommelier judging a wine recommender. A customer
with no wine knowledge made this request:

"It is freezing tonight, so I am looking for a light wine that everyone always likes."

The recommender suggested these 5 wines (described by a professional
tasting note):

Wine 1: Riesling, US, $25. Tasting note: "Apple and pear notes have a slightly savory tone in this brisk, lemony dry Riesling. Throughout a tasting of two samples, there are lingering tones of rubber and struck matches that blow off gradually with aeration."
Wine 2: Cabernet Sauvignon, US, $19. Tasting note: "Soft and fruity, this has ripe black-cherry and blackberry compote flavors, plus plenty of oak influence. Drink now."
Wine 3: Cabernet Sauvignon, US, $75. Tasting note: "Full, robust layers of black cherry and peppery tannins figure prominently on the palate of this fruit-forward wine that also manages to be lively in acidity. Spicy clove, black pepper and toasted oak add complexity and depth."
Wine 4: Cabernet Sauvignon, South Africa, $11. Tasting note: "A touch of vanilla and sweet oak graces the brambly black berry aromas and flavors in this wine. Medium weight and round in the mouth with fine tannins and a lively finish. Drink now."
Wine 5: Cabernet Sauvignon, US, $48. Tasting note: "This is a soft, still grippy Cabernet with an earthy, tobacco-infused character that somewhat overwhelms the taste of blackberry and black currant."

Rate how well each wine matches the request, using this scale:
5 = matches every wish in the request
4 = matches the main wishes, misses a minor one
3 = partly matches: right kind of wine but several wishes missed, or the reverse
2 = matches only a small part of the request
1 = does not match (wrong kind of wine, or contradicts a wish)
Judge only from the information given. A wish the information cannot
confirm (for example a price that is unknown) is neither a match nor a
mismatch.

Then rate the set:
- set_relevance: how useful the 5 wines are together as an answer to the request (1-5).
- occasion_fit: how well the wines suit the occasion in the request (1-5).

Think briefly about each wine before scoring it. Answer with JSON only, in
this form:
{"wines": [{"reason": "<one sentence>", "relevance": <1-5>}, ... one per wine, in order],
 "set_relevance": <1-5>, "occasion_fit": <1-5>}
